_comment: guardian config — deny blocks, ask prompts, anything unmatched runs. Patterns are plain text where * matches anything (case-sensitive); use "regex" for full regular expressions (flags supported, but no g/y). Entries target bash by default; add "tool" (write/edit) to guard file paths. This starter sticks to irreversible catastrophes (whole-home / filesystem-root / disk wipes, the .ssh folder) plus remote-destroying git and gh operations. Absolute paths cannot be portable, so nothing here names a specific home directory — if you want those rules too, add your own path to the regexes (much like the ~ / $HOME entries below). askTimeoutMs: an ask question left unanswered for this long counts as declined; drop the field to wait indefinitely.
